title: Logo source ladder
description: The ordered list of places a larger authored copy of a mark lives. build-branding-evidence.ts records which rungs were tried and what pixel size each returned (branding-evidence.json logo_sources.ladder); validate-fable-decision.ts refuses a trace or upscale logo_choice when no rung with min_useful_px >= min_source_px_for_trace was ever tried (source_ladder_incomplete) and marks traced_from_small_source on the decision when the best source is under that floor; the edge-quality gate carries the same floor. Prose about source hunting lives here, not in SKILL.md. Image search is a locator for authored assets, never a source to ship from.

rules.order: Try rungs in order. Stop when a rung returns a source at or above min_source_px_for_trace with the complete authored mark; still record every rung tried. Rungs below the floor are evidence, not shipping sources.
rules.record: Every tried rung is recorded as {rung, tried: true, longest_px, url, note, local_path}; an untried rung is recorded as {rung, tried: false, reason}. The best source is the largest authored copy of the current mark, not the largest file (a 2560px stock photo favicon is not a source).
rules.trace_only_after: A vector trace or upscale is allowed only after every rung with min_useful_px >= min_source_px_for_trace has been tried and recorded; the decision then carries traced_from_small_source and the variant sheet flags the default cell (label carries the native px); the closeout records the edge-quality override as Travisse's standing acceptance.
rules.no_generation: A generated or invented mark is never a rung; that path stays behind explicit approval (SKILL.md CUSTOM MARK CREATION).
rules.sign_wordmark_row: A storefront sign whose letterforms differ from the site logo yields a SHEET ROW generated flat with image-generator from the sign reference (never keyed from a perspective photo); added with `variant-sheet.mjs add-row --logo <generated.png> --label "sign wordmark, generated" --source <sign reference> --note "custom mark generated from the storefront sign"` (provenance imagegen_simplified in the evidence input); when that row is picked, the closeout records `run-file override --gate ink-retention --asset <png> --decided-by travisse --reason "custom mark pick"`; never a shipping source by itself (Shawarma, Buz, Slice, Koshari).
rules.social_avatar_keyed: When the max-size Instagram, Facebook or TikTok avatar IS the full lockup, key it from its disc or ground (sticker-panel.mjs --mode strip) and record it as a candidate with provenance social and the avatar's native px; it becomes its own sheet row.

rungs.label: site SVG (header, footer, inline <svg>, og/twitter image when .svg)
rungs.fetch_hint: curl the page HTML; grep ,

rungs.label: site header/footer PNG at its CDN original size
rungs.fetch_hint: strip resize params (wsimg /:/rs=w:..., squarespace ?format=..., wix /v1/fill/...); srcset and data-src often list the largest rendition

rungs.label: site @2x / srcset / retina rendition
rungs.fetch_hint: srcset descriptors 2x or w>=1400; <picture> sources; theme.json or CSS background-image at @2x

rungs.label: site og:image / twitter:image
rungs.fetch_hint: <meta property=og:image>; often 1200x630 with the lockup centered; crop is authored

rungs.label: site apple-touch-icon / manifest icons (180 to 512px)
rungs.fetch_hint: <link rel=apple-touch-icon>, site.webmanifest icons, /apple-touch-icon.png; usually a square crop of the mark

rungs.label: menu, catering, or event PDFs on the site
rungs.fetch_hint: links ending .pdf; pdfimages -list to find embedded raster/vector logos; pdftocairo -svg for vector marks

rungs.label: Toast ordering page logo
rungs.fetch_hint: order.toasttab.com/<slug>: the restaurant config JSON carries logoUrl at 1000px+ on toasttab CDN; also the og:image

rungs.label: ChowNow API restaurant logo
rungs.fetch_hint: api.chownow.com/api/restaurant/<id> returns logo.url at 1024px; the ordering page embeds the restaurant id

rungs.label: Clover online ordering logo
rungs.fetch_hint: www.clover.com/online-ordering/<slug>: merchant logo in the page JSON; CDN serves the original

rungs.label: SpotOn ordering logo
rungs.fetch_hint: order.spoton.com/<id>: __NEXT_DATA__ or the storefront API carries the logo asset

rungs.label: Slice listing logo
rungs.fetch_hint: slicelife.com/restaurants/<state>/<city>/<slug>: restaurant JSON logo field; images.slicelife.com serves originals

rungs.label: Square online site / ordering logo
rungs.fetch_hint: <slug>.square.site: header image at squarecdn original size (strip -size params); eGifter and gift-card pages reuse it

rungs.label: Uber Eats store listing logo
rungs.fetch_hint: ubereats.com/store/<slug>: the store JSON (__REACT_QUERY_STATE__) has heroImageUrls and a logo; food photos are not the mark

rungs.label: DoorDash store listing logo
rungs.fetch_hint: doordash.com/store/<slug>: bot wall to curl; use the live Chrome tab; store JSON carries coverSquareImageUrl and businessHeaderImageUrl

rungs.label: Facebook page avatar and cover at master size
rungs.fetch_hint: the scontent URL's cstp=mx<W>x<H> names the master size; drop stp= to get it; larger ctp values return signature-mismatch HTML; the cover photo needs the live tab

rungs.label: Instagram profile picture through the live Chrome tab
rungs.fetch_hint: instagram.com/<handle> header img in the live session (signed URLs 403 to curl and reject s<size> substitutions); export through the DevTools websocket; the profile render is often 896px+

rungs.label: TikTok profile avatar at max size
rungs.fetch_hint: tiktok.com/@<handle> page JSON carries avatarLarger (1080px); always pulled as a candidate next to the Instagram and Facebook avatars

rungs.label: Google Images results (locator only)
rungs.fetch_hint: review-canvas.mjs logo search through the live Chrome tab; a result is a pointer to an authored page, never a shipping source; follow it to a rung above

rungs.label: Google Business Profile owner photos (profile, cover, storefront sign)
rungs.fetch_hint: fetch-google-place-photos.mjs at maxWidthPx 4800; a photographed sign is a trace source only when nothing authored exists, and it is the last rung
